questions.question:
A question and two statements labeled (I) and (II) are given. You have to decide which statement(s) is/are sufficient to answer the question.

**Question:**

Among four friends - Arjun, Pavan, Neeraj and Sunil, who is the heaviest?

**Statements:**

I. Arjun and Pavan are of the same weight.

II. Pavan weighs more than Neeraj, but less than Sunil.

Select the right option from the following.

options.text: Both the statements together are needed.
Either I or II alone are sufficient.

questions.solution:
From statement 1 → Arjun = Pavan 

From statement 2 → Sunil > Pavan > Neeraj

From combining both statements,

Sunil > Arjun = Pavan > Neeraj

From both the statements Sunil is heaviest.

So, Both statements are needed for the answer.

Thus, the correct answer is Both the statements together are needed.

__
 
• Urban Cities - Remarkable town planning, and an excellent system of drainage and sanitation.
 
• Large cities divided into two parts-The ‘Citadel’ mound built on the high podium of mud-brick to the west. The town to the east was the main hub of the residential area, which was also surrounded by a massive brick wall.
 
• Streets-Fine drainage system, Well-arranged water supply system, The street lights system, Watch and ward arrangement during the night to oust the lawbreakers, Particular places to throw thrash and waste material, Public wells in every street, Well in every house, Main streets varying for 9 feet to as wide as 30-34 feet and were divided into networks of narrow lanes with great skills of dividing the cities.

• Great Granary-Great granary at Harappa measuring 169 fit x 135 fits. Attached to the granary were two-roomed tenements with a common courtyard.
 
• Great Bath-The overall dimension of the Great Public Bath is 180 feet by 108 feet. The bathing pool measured about 39 feet by 23 feet with 8 feet depth. There is a device to fill and empty the water of the bathing pool and the bathing pools were encircled with galleries and rooms.
 
• The urban planning of the Harappan has become a landmark for contemporary civilization and we can get a hint of the modern-day swimming pools and storehouses from their concept of bathing pools and granaries.

questions.question: Which among the following is the lowest computer storage size?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1 Megabyte**__.

__
 
• **The megabyte is a multiple unit byte for digital content**__. Its recommended symbol for the unit is MB.

 __
 
• The unit prefix mega is a multiplier of** 1000000 (10⁶)** in the International System of Units (SI).
 
• One megabyte is then one million bytes of information. This description has been adopted in the International System of Quantities.
 
• The human genome consists of 800 MB DNA of details.
 
• The pieces that separate one human from another can be compressed to 4 MB.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The gigabyte **is a multiple unit byte for digital content. The Giga prefix is **10⁹** in the International System of Units (SI). As a consequence, one gigabyte is one billion bytes. The gigabyte unit symbol is GB.
 
• **The petabyte** is a **10¹⁵** byte digital content. The unit name of the petabyte is PB. The name is composed of the SI Peta prefix-composed by a non-SI byte unit.
 
• **A terabyte **is a multiple unit byte for digital content. The prefix tera reflects the fourth power of 1000, which is **10¹²** in the International System of Units (SI), and thus one terabyte is one trillion (short scale) bytes. The unit sign of the terabyte is TB.

questions.question: The number of sides of a regular polygon whose interior angles are each 150° is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **regular polygon**, the sum of an **interior angle** and its corresponding **exterior angle** is always 180°.

Exterior angle = 180° − Interior angle = 180° − 150° = 30°.

The sum of all **exterior angles** of any polygon is always 360°.

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 30° = 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Each interior angle of the regular polygon = 150°.

**Formula Used:** Interior angle of a regular polygon with n sides = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0067fbb485ca49ef46af69b2c29cd0e14ffc3f67f7c0f532b6911ada1539e9c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 150° = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

⇒ 150n = (n − 2) × 180

⇒ 150n = 180n − 360

⇒ 180n − 150n = 360

⇒ 30n = 360

⇒ n = 360 ÷ 30

⇒ n = 12

Therefore, the correct option is 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of a polygon with n sides is given by the formula (n − 2) × 180°.

Exterior Angle Property

For any convex polygon, the sum of the exterior angles (one at each vertex) is always 360°.

Regular Polygon Properties

In a regular polygon, all sides are equal and all interior angles are equal. Each exterior angle = 360° ÷ n.

Supplementary Angles

The interior angle and the exterior angle at any vertex of a polygon are supplementary, meaning their sum is 180°.</p
